name: KrampusBasket
shape_prompt: Stylized 3D game accessory, chunky vinyl-toy style, smooth sculpted rounded forms. A tall, deep wicker backpack basket, like a grape-picker's back basket: taller than it is wide, rounded oval cross-section, slightly wider at the top, thick rolled rim, open top, no handle on top. Two shoulder straps on one flat side. Big enough to hold a person. Single object, empty, no character, no base.
texture_prompt: Bright saturated colours, smooth soft vinyl-toy finish. Golden-tan woven wicker with a slightly darker thick rolled rim, worn brown leather shoulder straps. No text, no logos.
